title: Speaker selection or continuation linked to prescribing volume
description: Paid speaker opportunities are selected, continued, increased or withdrawn based on prescribing behaviour rather than scientific/educational need and expertise.
legitimate_explanation: High-prescribing HCP may also be a genuine expert; prescribing volume alone is not dispositive.
aggravating_factors: Sales team tracks prescriptions; engagement follows increased prescribing; removal follows reduced prescribing; repeated fees without distinct educational need.
mitigating_factors: Documented need, objective expertise criteria, independent selection, FMV, actual service, no sales-linked metrics.
evidentiary_significance: May support inference that honoraria functioned as inducement rather than payment for genuine services.
russian_legal_relevance: Use as behavioural pattern only; test Russian facts separately under applicable law and Company Compliance Knowledge.

title: Payment for nominal or non-performed HCP service
description: Contract, speaker event or consultancy exists on paper but meaningful service is absent or unverifiable.
legitimate_explanation: Standardized materials or repeated topics may still reflect genuine services; verify actual performance and need.
aggravating_factors: No event; no audience; no deliverable; copied/nominal output; payment unrelated to work performed.
mitigating_factors: Contemporaneous agenda, attendance, deliverables, performance evidence, substantive expert contribution.
evidentiary_significance: Supports inference that contractual label concealed a different economic purpose.
russian_legal_relevance: Relevant to substance-over-form assessment and possible improper benefit; not a standalone offence definition.

title: Hospitality dominates educational/scientific purpose
description: Meals, venue, recreation or hospitality provide the main value while scientific/educational content is nominal or secondary.
legitimate_explanation: Reasonable meals ancillary to a genuine event can be legitimate.
aggravating_factors: Luxury venue, expensive alcohol, repeated social dinners, guests, minimal scientific content.
mitigating_factors: Substantive agenda, reasonable venue/cost, no entertainment, hospitality clearly secondary.
evidentiary_significance: May support inducement inference when combined with decision influence and business linkage.
russian_legal_relevance: Assess under Russian restrictions and applicable AIPM/company rules.

title: Travel linked to formulary, procurement or product switch
description: Travel or conference support is offered or provided in exchange for a favorable formulary, procurement, prescribing or switching decision.
legitimate_explanation: Travel directly related to genuine professional service/event may be permissible subject to law and policy.
aggravating_factors: Explicit linkage; unusual destination; premium/leisure component; decision-maker recipient; timing near decision.
mitigating_factors: Objective educational rationale, reasonable costs, no decision linkage, independent selection and pre-approval.
evidentiary_significance: Direct quid-pro-quo wording or timing can be strong evidence of improper influence.
russian_legal_relevance: Foreign examples are pattern-only; apply Russian anti-corruption/HCP rules separately.

title: Grant or donation tied to purchase/sale decision
description: Grant, donation or research support is conditioned on, timed to, or withheld pending a purchase or other business decision.
legitimate_explanation: Independent grants can be legitimate when separated from sales decisions and supported by genuine purpose.
aggravating_factors: Payment conditional on signed deal; sales personnel control grant; amount linked to sales; weak independent purpose.
mitigating_factors: Independent review, documented need, no sales condition, separate budget/governance, beneficiary transparency.
evidentiary_significance: Supports inference that ostensibly charitable/scientific funding is consideration for business.
russian_legal_relevance: Use as pattern; test Russian legal characterization independently.

title: Free equipment or use granted to a decision-maker
description: Free or heavily discounted equipment/use benefits an HCP/HCO decision-maker whose purchasing or clinical decisions matter to the supplier.
legitimate_explanation: Demo/loan programs can be legitimate if time-limited, documented, operationally necessary and not linked to purchase decisions.
aggravating_factors: Personal/private benefit; high value; indefinite use; recipient controls buying decision; no documented demo need.
mitigating_factors: Formal demo/loan policy, limited duration, asset tracking, no personal use, independent approval.
evidentiary_significance: Can evidence a transfer of value designed to influence purchasing.
russian_legal_relevance: Assess under Russian law and company policy; foreign case is pattern-only.

title: Expense category masks actual purpose of payment
description: Payment is booked/described as training, marketing, travel, clinical trial, conference, advertising or similar while actual purpose differs materially.
legitimate_explanation: Accounting categories can be broad; mismatch is meaningful only if substance is inaccurately represented.
aggravating_factors: Fictitious invoice; false description; retrospective documents; no underlying activity; approval routed to hide recipient/purpose.
mitigating_factors: Accurate description, supporting documentation, consistent accounting and actual service.
evidentiary_significance: May evidence concealment and knowledge of improper purpose.
russian_legal_relevance: Relevant to anti-corruption controls; 273-FZ art. 13.3 expressly lists preventing unofficial reporting and fake documents among possible measures.

title: Distributor-funded cash/benefit to hospital decision-maker
description: Distributor or intermediary provides cash/benefit to hospital decision-maker to reward or induce purchases while manufacturer may know, approve or benefit.
legitimate_explanation: Distributor discounts to customers can be ordinary commercial terms when transparent and paid to the contracting entity, not decision-makers personally.
aggravating_factors: Cash envelope/personal payment; manufacturer awareness; special funding; purpose tied to hospital purchase; suspicious success fee.
mitigating_factors: Transparent contract discount, entity-level payment, documented pricing rationale, third-party controls and monitoring.
evidentiary_significance: Creates third-party attribution and knowledge questions for manufacturer.
russian_legal_relevance: Russian attribution and liability require analysis under local law; foreign example is pattern-only.

title: Supplier participation in restrictive tender specification
description: Supplier participates in drafting procurement documentation or parameters in a way that restricts competition or favors predetermined suppliers/products.
legitimate_explanation: Providing objective technical information or responding to neutral market consultation is not equivalent to controlling the specification.
aggravating_factors: Non-public coordination; parameters tailored to one product; advance knowledge; bribe/benefit; exclusion of alternatives.
mitigating_factors: Customer independently defines need; multiple alternatives considered; objective published data; transparent consultation.
evidentiary_significance: May support inference of coordinated procurement manipulation, especially when combined with payment or predetermined winner.
russian_legal_relevance: Supported by official Russian enforcement notice; exact legal qualification depends on facts.

title: Benefit paid to secure or facilitate tender win
description: Payment or benefit is provided to a public/hospital decision-maker or intermediary for assistance in winning a healthcare procurement.
legitimate_explanation: Legitimate tender support/consultancy must not involve payment to decision-makers for favorable exercise of authority.
aggravating_factors: Explicit assistance in auction; intermediary routing; predetermined winner; restrictive tender design.
mitigating_factors: No personal benefit, transparent process, independent customer decision, documented legitimate services.
evidentiary_significance: Can trigger personal criminal exposure and corporate administrative exposure under art. 19.28 КоАП depending on facts.
russian_legal_relevance: Directly relevant to Russian official enforcement.

title: Benefit linked to favorable acceptance or performance treatment
description: Benefit is provided for loyal/favorable acceptance, signing acceptance documents or ignoring issues in contract performance.
legitimate_explanation: Ordinary contract-management communication and legitimate dispute resolution are distinct from personal benefits.
aggravating_factors: Recipient sits on acceptance function; payment coincides with acceptance; request for no claims; tender win and acceptance are bundled.
mitigating_factors: Independent documented acceptance criteria, no personal benefit, transparent defect/claim handling.
evidentiary_significance: Acceptance-related benefits appear in Russian 19.28 enforcement and Supreme Court review examples.
russian_legal_relevance: Directly relevant to Russian official enforcement.

title: Genuine HCP professional service with documented need and independence
description: HCP engagement is based on documented need, objective expertise, written scope, reasonable/FM V compensation, actual performance, disclosure where required and no obligation linked to prescribing/recommendation.
legitimate_explanation: This is the intended safe pattern.
aggravating_factors: None inherent; re-evaluate if recipient has decision influence or sales-linked selection.
mitigating_factors: Need-before-selection, objective criteria, FMV, deliverables, independent approval, conflict check.
evidentiary_significance: Creates contemporaneous evidence of legitimate purpose and service substance.
russian_legal_relevance: Aligned with AIPM industry standard and must remain within Russian law/company policy.

title: Reasonable HCP travel directly related to legitimate service/event
description: Travel/accommodation/meals are directly related to legitimate services/event, reasonable, documented and not used as reward or inducement.
legitimate_explanation: This is the intended safe pattern.
aggravating_factors: Luxury, leisure, companions, unusual destination, decision linkage.
mitigating_factors: Reasonable class/hotel, no entertainment, no companion cost, objective event relevance, pre-approval.
evidentiary_significance: Supports legitimate business purpose when consistent with actual event/service.
russian_legal_relevance: Aligned with AIPM standard subject to law/company rules.

title: Objective technical information without controlling customer procurement decision
description: Company provides accurate product characteristics and answers technical questions while public customer independently defines need, specification, alternatives and procurement conditions.
legitimate_explanation: This is the intended safe consultation boundary.
aggravating_factors: Drafting restrictive parameters, non-public competitive data, competitor documents, predetermined result.
mitigating_factors: Written objective materials, neutral questions, customer independence, alternative analysis, preserved communication.
evidentiary_significance: Creates evidence distinguishing technical consultation from procurement manipulation.
russian_legal_relevance: Must be evaluated against procurement/competition law and facts.
